Recently, Mophie has launched four new chargers for the iPhone. They can easily slide into your trouser pocket, come in two finishes, feature built-in charging cables, and pack 5000mAh or 10000mAh capacities. Although they aren't the smallest power banks on the market, the pricing is very attractive and definitely worth picking up.

Mophie's new PowerStation Plus power banks are divided into Standard and Signature series, each available in 5000mAh and 10000mAh capacities.

The Standard and Signature versions are the same size, but the Signature version features a better finish and comes with a braided charging cable.

All four models have a built-in USB-C charging cable, convenient for emergency device charging, though the cable cannot retract. The cable is built into the side of the power bank and can be pulled out when needed.

The three lower-end models of the PowerStation Plus come with one built-in charging cable, while the Signature 10K version has two braided cables. Combined with an additional USB-C port, up to three devices can be charged simultaneously.

As mentioned at the beginning, these power banks are by no means the smallest on the market, but they're not as bulky as many other products either. This design lets you easily slide them into your trouser pocket without being too conspicuous, no need to put them in a backpack. They also feature LED charging status indicator lights.

Every Mophie PowerStation Plus supports 20W power output via the USB-C port, and the same port is used to charge the power bank itself. The 5K version can fully charge an iPhone 17 Pro approximately once, while the 10K version can fully charge an iPhone 17 Pro twice. In light of recent power bank fire incidents, Mophie has also designed these products to be airplane-friendly.

You can purchase the Mophie PowerStation Plus from Amazon, with the product line starting from US$29.95 and going up to US$59.95.

  • PowerStation Plus 5K Standard Series – Amazon price US$29.95
  • PowerStation Plus 10K Standard Series – Amazon price US$39.95
  • PowerStation Plus 5K Signature Series – Amazon price US$39.95
  • PowerStation Plus 10K Signature Series – Amazon price US$59.95
